title: Final Equation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final equation for delta L in terms of the given variables.

title: Elastic Coefficient
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive the expression for the elastic coefficient k in terms of W and nu.

title: Thermal Change
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly relate the change in temperature to the change in entropy and its effect on length.

title: Partial Derivatives
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply partial derivatives in the derivation process.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect application of formulas.

title: Limiting Cases
description: Optional Criteria: The student could discuss limiting cases or special scenarios that validate the derived equation.
